title: Filled shapes and editable polygons
summary: Fill rectangles and ellipses, draw polygons, and preview color, opacity and side-count changes on the object.

Added: Fill/No Fill for rectangles, rounded rectangles, ellipses and polygons, with independent RGBA color and opacity.
Editable polygons with 3–64 sides, live resizing and one-step Undo. Geometry is adapted from MIT-licensed DesignCraft with attribution.
Verified: 122 Rust tests, formatting and strict Clippy; native Fill/No Fill, opacity and side-count Undo/Redo, live fill color, resizing and saved output.
Exact native clipboard comparisons plus real project save/reopen, alpha-compositing, invalid-input and old no-fill compatibility tests.

limitations: Rotation, per-corner rounding, stars, shadows, grouping and interactive crop remain unfinished.
Use alpha.31 or newer for projects containing polygons or general shape fills. Older builds may omit fills.
Unsigned Windows x64 alpha. Reference behavioral parity is not claimed; native tests use original synthetic fixtures.
